args.query: access rights roles review six months

gather.answer:
### What the evidence shows

The access control policy says: “Access to information is granted on the basis of the job a person does.” and “We start from no access and add only what the job needs.” It sets the review: “The access rights of all accounts, including administrator and technical accounts, are reviewed every six months by the role owners.”

The customer system access review covers the accounts staff hold in customers' systems: “The customers closed all five at our request by 7 July 2026 and confirmed it in writing.”

### What is missing

Nothing is missing.

requirements.reason: Access follows the job and is requested, approved and removed as the policy defines.
